title: Deterministic tree as a randomized tree
statement: Let a deterministic decision tree compute a function $f$ on inputs over a finite alphabet. It defines a randomized decision tree for $f$ by using a singleton seed space, assigning that seed probability one, and selecting the given tree.
hypotheses_covered: The tree computes the specified function
